subject: POC timeline: sprint milestones, acceptance gates, and handoff ceremony
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@fenwickhealth.com>, Ben Torres <ben.torres@fenwickhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC timeline: sprint milestones, acceptance gates, and handoff ceremony

Hi Claire / Ben —

Thanks again for the call today. This thread captures the agreed POC structure, measurable acceptance gates, and who owns what so we can hit an executive readout in three weeks. High-level summary first, then owners and next steps.

Summary (what we agreed on)
- 3-week POC starting June 8 (kickoff on June 8 at 10:00 PT)
- Weekly check-ins: Tuesdays 11:00–11:30 PT (sync + blockers)
- Final readout: June 29, 10:00 PT (internal + Fenwick execs)

Acceptance gates (quantitative where possible)
- Functional: End-to-end demo with sample queries and autocomplete scenarios (owner: Marissa)
- Quality: intent-match >= 0.86 on the prioritized 100-case prompt set; no regressions on 10 core test prompts (owner: Dylan)
- Latency: p95 generation latency < 350ms on dedicated trial configuration (owner: Karthik)
- Cost target: projected token cost <= $0.45 per 1k tokens in steady-state (owner: Soojin)

Milestones and owners
- June 8 (Kickoff): access to test environment, dataset handoff, baseline run (Soojin / Marissa)
- Week 1 (by June 15): baseline metrics and initial tuning (Dylan)
- Week 2 (by June 22): model configuration updates, caching/batching recommendations, and mid-point readout (Marissa + Karthik)
- Week 3 (by June 29): final acceptance run, readout deck, and handoff notes (Soojin + Marissa)

Key dependencies we flagged
- Fenwick to share a representative sample (CSV, anonymized) by June 6 (Ben)
- VPN/role-based access to the sandbox environment (IT contact) — Redwood to open support ticket if needed
- List of top 20 intents (Fenwick) for prioritized evaluation

Attachments: fenwick_eval_scope_v1.pdf (scope + test plan), evaluation-rubric.xlsx (rubric we will run against).

Next steps (actionable)
1) Ben — drop the anonymized sample CSV into the shared Drive link and confirm by EOD June 6.
2) Soojin — send calendar invites for kickoff + weekly cadence (today).
3) Marissa/Dylan/Karthik — confirm owners and prepare the baseline scripts before June 8.

If anything above is off, please flag edits inline. Otherwise I’ll send invites and the kickoff agenda.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0126

Attachment stubs: fenwick_eval_scope_v1.pdf (16 pages, scope & sample prompts), evaluation-rubric.xlsx (sheet: metrics, thresholds).

Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline: sprint milestones, acceptance gates, and handoff ceremony

Thanks Soojin — this looks good and mirrors what we discussed. A few clarifications:
- We’ll anonymize the CSV and upload by EOD June 6 (I’ll confirm when it’s done).
- For the latency gate: our primary concern is p95 on peak traffic (we expect short bursts during business hours). Can Redwood simulate burst conditions in the sandbox?
- For cost: can you provide a short projection (ballpark) for both hosted trial and a Dedicated scenario?

We’ll confirm times for the weekly sync after we see the invites. Looking forward to kickoff.

Ben
Head of Integrations, Fenwick Health
ben.torres@fenwickhealth.com | +1 (612) 555-3344

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 10:59:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline: sprint milestones, acceptance gates, and handoff ceremony

Onboarding update — kicked off this morning at 10:00 PT with Fenwick. Quick notes:
- Access: test sandbox credentials provisioned, sample CSV received (Ben) — thanks.
- Baseline run: completed 50-case baseline, intent-match = 0.72, p95 latency = 480ms (hosted trial config)
- Short plan: prioritize tokenization and small context-window tuning this week to drive down p95. Karthik will run quantization profile tests and local batching changes.

Immediate asks for Fenwick:
1) Please confirm the top 10 intents for priority evaluation (reply to this thread).
2) If you have a list of 3–5 high-risk / high-sensitivity prompts, mark them so we can add manual review checks.

I’ll post the Week 1 baseline CSV + metric table into the Drive link by EOD.

—Dylan
Senior ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com

From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@fenwickhealth.com>

Subject: Re: POC timeline: sprint milestones, acceptance gates, and handoff ceremony

Thanks team — appreciate the clear notes and the baseline. A couple quick replies:
- Top 10 intents attached in the Drive (filename: fenwick_top10_intents.csv).
- High-risk prompts: added a sheet in the Drive called sensitive_prompts.xlsx. We’ve flagged three items.
- Burst testing: yes please — we’d like a short report on p95 under 3x baseline traffic. If you can run that during Week 2 that would be ideal.

We’re aligned on the June 29 readout — Ben and I will loop in the product lead once we have the mid-point results.

See you on Tuesday’s check-in.

Claire
